official_score.reason_not_recalculated: A fresh official run includes live-release and other network-bound observations. This local-safe audit did not create network traffic or external mutations, so the latest official score is retained without inflation.

hardening_completed.change: Root discovery now executes custom safety scripts, rejects configured zero-test modules and includes Instagram publisher safety.
Human listening and visual evidence are exact asset-hash bound; missing listening is a publication blocker, while hash, origin and visual drift remain structural failures.
Instagram verifies bounded no-redirect hosted bytes and reauthorizes before mutation; TikTok reruns the media guard and exact file hash immediately before upload and Post.
Collision tombstones bind the exact full occurrence set; a new third occurrence invalidates the old tombstone and hard-blocks.
AccessTrade frozen CSV intake supports multiple rows with order-independent exact row binding and rejects missing, extra, replayed or duplicate rows.
Missing Content-Type fallback is restricted to exact configured same-host RSS/Atom bytes with bounded size, exact hash and parsed feed root; malformed, replayed or redirected evidence fails closed.
The improvement runtime contract now binds policy, identity, publisher, authority, active media, QA receipts and weekly manifest dependencies.
The origin gate reports allow-list declarations as attestations and no longer overclaims that Flow output is proven absent.
